annotate_getitem_nodes_graph: annotate getitem nodes in a torch.fx.Graph with inferred types from Tuple, List, and NamedTuple sequences
annotate_getitem_nodes_tuple: annotate getitem nodes in a torch.fx.Graph to infer element types from Tuple sequence nodes
annotate_getitem_nodes_list: annotate getitem nodes in a torch.fx.Graph to infer element types from List sequence nodes
annotate_getitem_nodes_namedtuple: annotate getitem nodes in a torch.fx.Graph to infer field types from NamedTuple sequence nodes
annotate_getitem_nodes_jit_scriptability: annotate getitem nodes in a torch.fx.Graph to restore type annotations and improve JIT scriptability
